name: lpn_accept_realizes_eq
doc:
Every shared-contract LPN realizer has the ideal reduction's exact acceptance probability.
Reduction glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Only layout-length coin words are used.

**Proof sketch.** Read canonical acceptance, reindex B's coins by the shared coin
bijection, and use the mandatory runAt_coinsEquivPoly_symm reader. The named reduction
reader leaves the adversary's coin prefix. Its existing uniform restriction law and
ofFn/take reader recover exactly the shorter adversary coin distribution.

name: lpn_fix_advice
doc:
One advice tuple dominates the adjacent LPN chain gap under the actual nuisance law.
Averaging glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. No realizer occurs in this statement.

**Proof sketch.** Keep the actual generator draw, buckets, seed, repetition table, uniform
public vectors and comparison tail in one finite nuisance product. The fixed-advice
section identities expose the canonical challenged matrix and fresh selected value.
Compose the existing typed product/Fubini laws, move that matrix before the seed/table,
and use the public coordinate-resampling law. The two acceptance probabilities are
therefore averages under the same actual law. Absolute-gap convexity and the existing
finite averaging selector fix one tuple before any machine realizer is introduced.
